title: A bird's-eye view: Meaning and Examples — Word Power 49
content:
## A bird's-eye view

**Word Power 49 · English idioms**

### Meaning

A wide view seen from high up; a general survey of a subject.

### Usage

1. If we climb the tower, we'll have a bird's-eye view of the town.
2. I want a book that gives a bird's-eye view of Rajasthan.

### Your turn

Use “a bird's-eye view” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
